business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

counted_linked_issues.description: Open Fix, Test, and Verification issues linked to the escalation that the v5 standard counts.

coverage_item_or_resource.description: Immutable item or resource whose requirement and eligible coverage were reconciled.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

earliest_qualified_base_block.description: First free block of a qualified engineer on or after standard verified readiness (ISO date).

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

expedite_completion_days_saved.description: Days the expedited partner start saves after the staff calendar is reapplied.

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Wrenfield's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on WRN-30455.

external_recovery_quantity.description: Uncovered STORY_POINT that the external recovery must cover.

ineligible_coverage_quantity.description: points held by engineers without integrations-api level 2, by the on-call engineer, or removed for approved leave

leave_points_excluded.description: Points removed from qualified engineers for approved leave on the remaining sprint days.

observed_coverage_quantity.description: Gross observed coverage for remaining sprint 27 points of squad engineers on the 2026-04-10 capacity report before exclusions.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

qualified_engineers.description: Squad engineers on the capacity report who hold the required skill at level 2+ and are not on call.

quantity_unit.description: Unit shared by the requirement and coverage calculations: STORY_POINT.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental cost of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing partner_standard_start, expedite_partner_start, drop_committed_work_to_pull_in.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

required_quantity.description: story points required to close ESC-3134 (open Fix, Test, and Verification issues under the v5 standard)

selected_engineer_block.description: Engineer and block used by the selected option, as EMPLOYEE/YYYY-MM-DD/SESSION.

shortage_quantity.description: Uncovered STORY_POINT after netting eligible coverage from the requirement.

sprint_end_date.description: Last day of the active sprint that bounds 'this sprint' (ISO date).

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Wrenfield's confirmed standard and expedited delivery dates on WRN-30455.

usable_coverage_quantity.description: Net eligible coverage after removing points held by engineers without integrations-api level 2, by the on-call engineer, or removed for approved leave.
